title: Fractions, percentages and units - 123 school
heading: Fractions, percentages and units
intro: Test your knowledge by typing your answer and comparing it with the correct answer. Then click 'Check answers'.
All the data you need is in the question. Every question tells you how to round.

questions.q: You multiply a density of 0.79 g/mL by a volume of 50 mL. What unit does the answer have?
What does a molar mass of 18 g/mol mean?
questions.a: 1 mol has a mass of 18 g
questions.e: You read g/mol as "grams per mole": 1 mol has a mass of 18 g

questions.q: You divide a mass in g by a molar mass in g/mol. What unit does the answer have?
You divide an amount in mol by a concentration in mol/L. What unit does the answer have?
0.4 L of solution contains 0.15 mol of dissolved substance. Calculate the concentration in mol/L. Round to 3 decimal places.
A quantity of 60 g increases by 35%. How many grams is it afterwards? You do not need to round.
A mixture consists of 28 g of iron and 16 g of sulfur. What is the mass ratio iron : sulfur?
Convert 3750 mL to L. Round to 1 decimal place.
questions.e: 1 L = 1000 mL, so 3750 mL = 3.75 L, rounded 3.8 L

questions.q: Convert 480 L to m<sup>3</sup>. You do not need to round.
Convert 0.25 h to s. You do not need to round.
A speed of 36 km/h in m/s is equal to …
Convert 100 km/h to m/s. Round to 1 decimal place.
